note: Mission-conditioned task registry. Tolerances are declared engineering tolerances (assumptions), not measured error bars; the evaluation varies them by x0.5 and x2. Status thresholds are expressed in tolerance units: match = exp(-z^2/2), so 0.6065 is z = 1 tolerance and 0.1353 is z = 2 tolerances.

order: SITE_CONSTRAINT: a hard site constraint fails -> NON_TRANSFERABLE (the site cannot host the operation).
PHYSICS_PRIMARY: a primary physical dependency is not reproducible in the field and has no correction model -> NON_TRANSFERABLE.
EVIDENCE: available factor weight fraction below the task's min_evidence -> UNKNOWN.

SUPPORTED: lower bootstrap bound of the task match >= 1-tolerance threshold, evidence quality >= supported_min_quality, primary-factor resolution sufficient, and no primary physics dependency that is only partially reproducible or model-corrected.
CONDITIONAL: point match >= 2-tolerance threshold but a caveat applies (CI below threshold, low evidence quality, insufficient resolution, or a partial/model-corrected primary physics dependency).
WEAK: point match below the 2-tolerance threshold.
Secondary physics dependencies never change the status; they are listed as certificate limitations and red-team findings.

slope_dist.name: Slope distribution (multi-scale)
slope_dist.metric: Wasserstein-1 between slope distributions at 200, 400 and 800 m cells (central differences)

roughness.name: Detrended local roughness (600 m windows)
roughness.metric: Wasserstein-1 between log10 residual-std distributions after 3x3 plane removal

fine_slope.name: Fine-baseline slope P90 (target baseline)
fine_slope.metric: Absolute difference at the target fine baseline (100 m Moon, 400 m Mars)

surface_cover.name: Bare surface fraction
surface_cover.metric: at_least 0.8 with tau 0.2 (target bare by definition)

illumination_geometry.name: Solar illumination geometry
illumination_geometry.metric: Moon: existing EGIZ low-Sun light fidelity (NOAA, monthly windows); Mars: Wasserstein-1 between NASA SPICE daylight solar-elevation distributions (Earth: 12 monthly days; Jezero: 12 epochs across a Mars year)

irradiance.name: Direct solar irradiance (Sun-tracking, period mean)
irradiance.metric: Absolute log10 ratio of modelled mean direct irradiance on a Sun-tracking surface, including night (CF_SOLAR)

tasks.name: DEM-based hazard mapping rehearsal
tasks.description: Rehearse slope/roughness hazard mapping and avoidance planning from orbital-class DEMs.
limitations: Lander-scale (metre) hazards such as boulders are not resolved by any input DEM.

tasks.name: Rover route planning and autonomous navigation
tasks.description: Exercise route planners and autonomy on terrain geometry statistically similar to the target region.
limitations: Traversability thresholds depend on wheel-soil behaviour, which is not transferred by terrain geometry.

tasks.name: Wheel-soil traction and sinkage qualification
tasks.description: Qualify wheel traction, sinkage and drawbar pull.
limitations: Field soils are unmeasured; reduced-gravity soil strength effects are empirically documented and not reproduced at 1 g.

tasks.name: EVA field-geology traverse training
tasks.description: Train crews and science teams on geological traverses and observation planning.
limitations: Suit mobility under reduced gravity and pressurisation is not reproduced.

tasks.name: Geological sampling protocol rehearsal
tasks.description: Rehearse sample selection, documentation and handling protocols.
limitations: Mineralogy and lithology are not inferred from DEMs.

tasks.name: Solar array siting and energy-constrained scheduling
tasks.description: Plan array placement and operations against solar geometry and available irradiance.
limitations: No terrain horizon shadowing at the Earth sites; panel temperature and dust deposition not modelled.

tasks.name: Low-Sun crew and robotic operations
tasks.description: Rehearse perception and operations under long, low-angle shadows.
limitations: Natural Earth low-Sun windows are seasonal and short compared with lunar polar illumination.

tasks.name: Line-of-sight and communications geometry planning
tasks.description: Plan line-of-sight between assets and relay placement over terrain.
limitations: Direct-to-Earth and relay-orbiter geometry is not reproduced by terrestrial sites.

tasks.name: Habitat and landing-pad site layout
tasks.description: Lay out habitat, pad and keep-out zones against flat-terrain availability and thermal environment.
limitations: Radiation shielding and thermal design are outside field-analog scope.

tasks.name: Excavation and regolith ISRU operations
tasks.description: Excavate, haul and process regolith; prospect volatiles.
limitations: Excavation forces scale with gravity and soil strength; volatile behaviour requires cryo-vacuum testing.

tasks.name: Dust mitigation and contamination control
tasks.description: Test dust tolerance of mechanisms, seals and optics.
limitations: Lunar electrostatic dust and low-pressure Martian aeolian transport are not reproduced outdoors on Earth.

tasks.name: Cold, dry surface operations
tasks.description: Operate equipment in persistently cold and arid surface conditions.
limitations: Earth and target temperatures/precipitation were not acquired.

missions.name: Jezero rover mobility and geology campaign
